name: Balthazar of Isan
source:
Balthazar of Isan is a student at the College for Humanitarian Arcana in Qatt, who attends the Conclave of the Universal Panacea after a personal invitation from Zeno of Apocyrion. He is an Entropic Thanatomancer like Utsushikome of Fusai, but she strongly dislikes him.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Balthazar_of_Isan]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
